_comment: The share cards. One per chapter, plus the title page. Read by lib/seo.ts (which card a route gets, and its alt text) and by scripts/og-cards/render.mjs (what gets drawn). Every `title` is the page's own h1 or chapter name, and every `line` is quoted from the page itself — nothing here is written for the card. Change a page's opening words, change them here, then re-run the script. Questions is back matter, so its card carries no number. Routes with no entry (/errata, /a-z, /_not-found) get the title page.
